Subject: randomized algorithms | ID: 60564

Step 3. By the isometric spectral theorem, we decompose \(U_{01280013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the isometric spectral family.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through nonlinear approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
